theorem lg_target : Nat.choose 10 3 = 120 := by
  rw [Nat.choose_mul_right (by norm_num : 3 ≠ 0)]
  rw [Nat.choose_one_right 3]
  rw [Nat.choose_mul_right (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0)]
  rw [Nat.choose_one_right 2]
  rw [Nat.choose_mul_right (by norm_num : 1 ≠ 0)]
  rw [Nat.choose_one_right 1]
  rfl
